definitions.gloss: free sample; trial product; sample product
definitions.explanation: A product given away free of charge for promotional purposes so that potential customers can try it before purchasing.

examples.japanese: {試供品|しきょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{試供品|しきょうひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いていた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: A free sample of a new shampoo was included.

examples.japanese: ⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{試供品|しきょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}っていた→配る：03921_kubaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧きた。
examples.english: They were handing out free samples at the cosmetics counter, so I got a few.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in marketing and retail contexts. {試供品|しきょうひん} are often small-sized versions of products, especially cosmetics, food, and beverages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試供品|しきょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧ (to hand out samples)
- {試供品|しきょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive a sample)
- {試供品|しきょうひん}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (comes with a sample)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サンプル→サンプル：10939_sanpuru⟧: sample — the loanword equivalent, also commonly used
- ⟦{見本|みほん}→見本：00279_mihon⟧: sample, specimen — used more broadly for display samples
